description: Permanently remove entries from one day of the diary: foods, exercises, notes or biometrics, by the ids get_diary returns. Never guess an id; read the day first.

confirm.description: Must be true. Confirm only after the user directly requested this change.

date.description: A date: YYYY-MM-DD, "today", "yesterday", or "N days ago" (resolved in the diary timezone).

entry_ids.description: serving_id, exercise_id, note_id or biometric_id values from get_diary.

items.description: A Cronometer id from an earlier tool result.

name: remove_diary_entries
title: Delete Diary Entries
